title: Affine formal quotient projections are surjective with ideal-power kernel
statement: Let A be a commutative ring, I an ideal of A, and J the ideal sheaf on Spec A associated with I through ΓSpecIso. Let M be any A-module and m>0. The linear map p from M to the A-module of global sections of formalModuleQuotient J m (tilde M), defined as the tilde/global-sections unit followed by global sections of formalModuleQuotientπ, is surjective and its kernel is I^m M. This uses the explicit products, powers and cokernel of def-weil-pbc-coherent-formal-module.

source.place: Tags 01I8 and 01IC; Tag 087W in coherent.tex, affine module correspondence

proof.text: Apply the surjectivity and kernel component theorems to the identical map p and assemble the conjunction. The surjectivity component is proved using quasi-coherence and the affine cokernel-image theorem; the kernel component remains open.

lean.statement:
theorem formalModuleQuotient_affine_projection
    (A : Type u) [CommRing A] (I : Ideal A)
    (J : (Spec (CommRingCat.of A)).IdealSheafData)
    (hJ : J = Scheme.IdealSheafData.ofIdealTop
      (I.map (Scheme.ΓSpecIso (CommRingCat.of A)).inv.hom))
    (M : ModuleCat.{u} A) (m : ℕ) (hm : 0 < m) :
    let p := (tilde.toTildeΓNatIso (R := CommRingCat.of A)).hom.app M ≫
      (moduleSpecΓFunctor (R := CommRingCat.of A)).map
        (formalModuleQuotientπ J m ((tilde.functor (CommRingCat.of A)).obj M))
    Function.Surjective p ∧ LinearMap.ker p.hom = I ^ m • (⊤ : Submodule A M)
